metadata.title: Qafotel | Hotel & Jardin Coffee
metadata.description: Experience quiet luxury in nature. A boutique hotel and Jardin Coffee in the heart of the city.

home.roomsTitle: Designed for rest. Curated for you.
home.storyTitle: An oasis of calm in the modern world.
home.storyText: We believe that true luxury lies in the space to breathe. Qafotel was designed as an architectural sanctuary where organic textures meet refined minimalism. Every detail, from the linen sheets to the curated gardens, is chosen to restore and inspire.

features.safeDesc: Your safety and privacy are our priority.

about.storyText: Founded in 2026, QAFOTEL was born from a simple belief: luxury should feel natural. Nestled in a converted botanical estate, our hotel blends contemporary design with the timeless beauty of the natural world. Every detail, from our hand-selected organic linens to our locally sourced Jardin Coffee, reflects our commitment to sustainability and refined craftsmanship.
about.missionText: To create a sanctuary where modern luxury and nature coexist in perfect harmony. We believe in slow travel, conscious hospitality, and the transformative power of quiet spaces.
about.styleText: Our design philosophy draws from the organic textures of the natural world. Raw oak, hand-thrown ceramics, and linen textiles create an atmosphere that is both elevated and deeply grounding.

facilities.heroText: Discover spaces designed to ground you in nature while elevating your senses.

jardinCoffee.title: Jardin Coffee
jardinCoffee.text: A bustling yet intimate café offering ethically sourced, single-origin roasts and artisanal pastries baked fresh daily using ingredients from our garden.

meetingRoom.title: Meeting Rooms
meetingRoom.text: Elegant, fully equipped meeting spaces designed for productive gatherings. Natural light, ergonomic furniture, and seamless connectivity for up to 30 guests.

outdoorGarden.title: Outdoor Garden
outdoorGarden.text: Wander through our lush outdoor garden filled with tropical greenery. A serene space for morning walks, quiet reading, or simply reconnecting with nature.

cityView.title: City View Terrace
cityView.text: Sweeping panoramic views of the city skyline from our rooftop terrace. Perfect for sunset cocktails, evening relaxation, or simply taking in the vista.

rooms.heroSubtitle: Refined spaces for the conscious traveler.

leaf.name: The Leaf Room
leaf.description: A cozy green retreat wrapped in natural textures, perfect for a peaceful night surrounded by garden views.

oase.name: The Oase Room
oase.description: Our most spacious room with a breathtaking panoramic view — more room to breathe, and the best scenery in the house.
